description: ADR-598 G14 — type-complexity budget policy (SSoT for the ratchet tolerance & severity bands). Mirrors config/quality-gates/ts-error-budget.json (ADR-027). The floor itself lives in .type-complexity-baseline.json; this file only governs how much jitter is tolerated before a rise blocks.

notes.heapWarnPct: ADR-757 ΦΑΣΗ Β — warn (never block) when tsc's own reported memory reaches this share of the heap ceiling in force. The ceiling itself is NOT a policy knob: it is derived from host RAM in scripts/lib/tsc-runner.js, because --max-old-space-size is a ceiling, not a reservation, and a number copy-pasted between machines is how this gate died silently.
